sources.description: Transparent overdrive for guitar bass—breakup and sparkle without coloring your amp. Hand-soldered in Canada. Player-tested by Michael Schau. Watch demos.

Menu Cart 0 Fuzz Pedals Crunch Overdrive Products Video Demos Press Our Story Special Orders Contact Log in Create account Fuzz Pedals Crunch Overdrive Products Video Demos Press Our Story Special Orders Contact Home › Crunch Transparent Overdrive McGregor Pedals Crunch Transparent Overdrive Regular price $185.00 USD Sale price Unit price / per Shipping calculated at checkout. Original Crunch (Low Gain) - $185.00 USD Extra Crunch (~30% More Gain) - $185.00 USD Quantity Add to Cart Transparent overdrive for working guitarists and bassists. Adds breakup and sparkle without coloring the signature sound of your instrument—the pedal pros reach for when they need edge-of-breakup drive, not another flavor overlay. ▶ Watch video demos | Press release Why pros use the Crunch Truly transparent — soft, amp-like clipping that reacts with your rig, not against it Your tone stays yours — ideal for blues, roots, low-gain rhythm, session work (wherever you need to maintain the tone of your guitar) Dynamic quiet — responds to picking dynamics and changes in volume; High quality parts = low noise. Board-friendly — top-mounted jacks, 7–10 mA draw, LED brightness trim for outdoor stages Hand-soldered in British Columbia, Canada — high-grade components, true bypass Which version is for you? Version Best for Look Original Crunch Maximum transparency and subtle edge-of-breakup—the reference low-gain transparent overdrive Standard knobs / LED Extra Crunch Same open character with ~30% more gain—more of a “dirt box” when you want it; stacks beautifully with Original Black knobs, blue LED Select your version above before adding to cart. Trusted by working players “The Extra Crunch is an incredibly open and airy sounding overdrive. It really keeps your original sound intact while giving you a bit of amp-like grind. Killer pedal!” — Joey Landreth , The Bros. Landreth “The number one pedal on my board. Absolutely great for getting a fantastic blues, roots, or low-gain rhythm or lead tone without coloring the tone of my guitar or amp. Just an invaluable tone tool for the professional guitarist.” — Michael Schau , blues/rock session player “Run the Crunch to taste and experience a ‘super transparent’ overdrive whose overtones and harmonics are musically focused. My first test strum gave me goose bumps—it felt so real and unprocessed. It retains your core amp tone signature… almost impossible to make it sound bad when twirling the knobs.” — Anthony DellaCroce , The Headpins “I've never been much of a pedal guy, but once I played a Crunch, I found the one pedal I can't live without. Just enough push to warm up my guitar no matter the situation or amp.” — Tom Holland , James Cotton Band “Excels as a boost in front of an amp’s overdrive channel, adding touch-sensitive crunch, clarity, and sustain without muddy overtones or buzzy top-end. Tested well with single-coils and humbuckers, retaining their inherent tones.” — Vintage Guitar Magazine (VG Approved Gear) , September 2021 Read the full Vintage Guitar review → More reviews press → Video demos How to use it Stand-alone transparent overdrive: Start with Volume, Tone, and Gain at 1 o'clock. Bring up Gain for crunch; bring up Volume to push your amp's front end. Preamp before another pedal: Same starting point—dial to taste. Dirty boost after other pedals: Dial it in; it stacks nicely with other pedals. Always-on preamp: Last in chain, leave on—helps restore feel on boards with stacked buffered bypass pedals. After fuzz: into a cranked amp—especially sweet with The Classic Fuzz . LED brightness: Side trim pot (jeweler's screwdriver)—from dark stage to bright sun. Specifications Type: Low-gain transparent overdrive (guitar bass) Controls: Volume, Tone, Gain Bypass: True bypass (high-quality Alpha stomp switch) Power: 9 V DC, center-negative 2.1 × 5.5 m

Simple three control pedal (Vol, Gain, Tone) makes it easy and fast to dial in a killer tone. The Crunch Transparent Overdrive pedal started one afternoon when the best guitar player I know, told me that he could never find a low-gain overdrive pedal that was truly transparent. I figured it was time to use my physics background; I started researching and came up with a proof of concept as well as a long list of modifications/improvements. sources.description: Menatone メナトーン Blue Collar Mojo PTP オーバードライブ ギターエフェクター・Red Snapperのゲインとコンプレッションを高めたサウンド・クリーントーンからフルゲインまで広いゲインレンジ・ポイントtoポイント、最高級コンポーネントを採用Blue Collarオーバードライブは、Menaoneにとって2番目に完成したペダルデザインです。Red Snapperにより高いゲインとコンプレッションを求めるリクエストから1997年に開発されたのがBlue Collarでした。Blue Collar Mojo PTPは、最高級のハンドメイドペダルを作り続けてきたMenatoneによるMojoバージョンです。Mojoバージョンは、ハイエンドアンプに使用されているものと同様のプレミアムコンポーネントを採用し、9〜18V駆動に対応させました。過去最高のBlue Collarです。特にシングルコイルとの相性がよく、ミッドレンジが太いトーンを生み出します。1台でクリーントーンから倍音とサステインが豊かで美しくなめらかなフルゲインまで、広いゲインレンジをカバーします。スム

THE LAW BENDER $259 Add to Cart DEMOS Coming soon... The Law Bender Deluxe is the next evolution of the Menatone Law fuzz. Based on the same circuit but with the added 'PORK' control for more gain. The PORK control turns the first gain stage from a unity gain buffer, to a 12db exrtra boost stage similar to a MKii fuzz. The Law Bender goes from light overdrive to full blown nastiness. The new Deluxe version now has both silicone and germanium tranistors switchable in both stages. The Silicon has more gain on tap and a tigher response, while the Germanium has more midrange and an organic vibe with a bit less gain. Both provide a hugely dynamic experience with clarity and nuance not found in any other fuzz pedals. 1/2 Watt Carbon resistors and rolled poly caps are used throughout. NONE MORE BLACK Top of Page None More Black Deluxe The None More Black is an ultra high gain distortion that takes concepts from all of my favorite amps from the 80s to the present. No clipping diodes and no op amps, this purely discrete circuit oozes an organic character that eludes other pedals in the field. Its unique eq controls allow for a very wide range of tones from ultra scooped to modern midrange punch. The gain control goes from vintage 800 style to all out mayhem. Scroll down for more info. Build time is usually 4-6 weeks or so $259 Add to Cart DEMOS All demos played poorly by Menatone unless otherwise noted. Amp is a princeton style 5w running into a Ox Amp Top Box. Amp settings are very clean to not hide the sound of the pedal. bridge PAF 4x12 V30

Menatone None More Black Deluxe Overdrive Distortion Guitar Effect Pedal quantity Add to cart Description The Menatone None More Black is an amalgamation of many of Brian Mena’s beloved high gain amplifiers. Taking the best components of each, he has created a unique and unique sound that pays homage to various German-named amps and rigs powered by fuel. The gain of the None More Black ranges from hot rodded 800, to crazy, in your face, all out insanity. The SUCK knob can take the mid range from all the way gone, to crazy gobs of fat, vocal, goodness, while the PRES gives total control of the high end. This deceptively simple arrangement gives a surprisingly complete control of the tonal palette. ***Please note, due to the small quantities in whichMenatone pedals are made, they are subject to change in appearance only at any given moment. Red Snapper 4kb PTP $229 Add to Cart The Red Snapper is the pedal that started it all for Menatone. It debuted in 1996 in its original 3 knob form made point to point, one at a time and is still made the same way 30 years later. The concept was simple, make the most transparent touch sensitive overdrive that could possibly be made, and three decades later it still holds up. The four knob version adds the hi cut control that is designed in such a way that it is completely out of the circuit when turned all the way down, but adds a level of tonal versatility that the three knob original cannot match. The Red Snapper is Menatone's flagship overdrive, a touch-sensitive drive that debuted in 1996 and became a template for transparent, amp-like overdrive. The four-knob version keeps the original Volume, Tone and Gain and adds a hi-cut control that disengages fully when turned down, taming top end for bright amps and single-coils. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Menatone Wreck'T Back to results Menatone Wreck'T Overdrive Distortion Amp-in-a-box drive after a Fischer/Trainwreck-style amp, from AC30 chime to Plexi roar. The Wreck'T is an amp-in-a-box overdrive and distortion voiced after the hand-built amplifiers of Ken Fischer, mixing British amp character with an American gain structure. A full amp-style control set of Drive, Tone, Level, Presence and Cut lets it move from AC30-style chime at lower gain up to a Plexi-style roar when pushed, with the Presence and Cut controls shaping the top end like a real amp's. Rather than a simple boost it's meant to be a preamp-like main drive. The current version has updated top-mounted jacks, hand-built in the USA. sources.bodyExcerpt: Mesa Boogie Flux-Five | ToneFoo ToneFoo Home Tones Stacks Pedals ToneFoo Pedal Mesa Boogie Flux-Five The Mesa/Boogie Flux-Five is an overdrive pedal built around the company’s Flux-Drive circuit, with added flexibility from a smaller version of Mesa’s five-band graphic EQ and footswitchable HI/LO gain modes. It is designed to move from low- to medium-gain breakup into thicker, higher-gain saturation, with the LO mode covering the original Flux-Drive style and the HI mode adding more drive. The five-band EQ can be assigned to either mode or both, letting players shape the pedal toward a Mesa-style “V-curve” or use it for broader tone shaping. Mesa describes it as retaining the Flux family’s warm, expressive character while adding more output and EQ control. It was introduced in 2014 as part of Mesa/Boogie’s pedal lineup. The pedal uses true bypass switching and runs on 9V battery or standard 9V DC power. sources.bodyExcerpt: MojoHandFX - 1979 Search Sign in or Register ( ) close Sign in or Register PEDALS ALL PEDALS BOOST COMPRESSION DELAY REVERB FUZZ MODULATION FILTER OVERDRIVE DISTORTION LIMITED EDITION B STOCK Merchandise Retailers U.S. Dealers International Dealers International Distributors About Us INFO SUPPORT Contact Us Discontinued FAQ, Shipping, Payments Warranty/Repairs/Service Terms of Service California Prop 65 Health Safety Warning Home PEDALS 1979 - OpAmp Fuzz 1979 - OpAmp Fuzz SKU: UPC: 850039942082 $169.00 (You save ) Current Stock: Adding to cart… The item has been added Facebook Email Print Close × Description Say "hello" to the 1979! An evolution of the now discontinued Mojo Hand FX 1978, the 1979 is based on the notoriously high gain Big Muffs that were manufactured during the late 70s. Favored by many players for it’s outrageous grungy distortion (most notably Billy Corgan), it features op-amps instead of the traditional transistors found in every other Big Muff variant. The 1979 features a footswitch to bypass the tone knob, so you get ALL the bass, ALL the treble, and a HUGE helping of extra mids and volume. Perfect for slamming your amp into a ripping solo, or doom/stoner mode. But most importantly, the tone bypass has it’s own volume knob so you can set it to unity or boost! We also adjusted the taper of the original gain pot to have a more usable sweep. This peculiar Muff uses an IC, instead of the traditional transistor set, resulting in something that’s both familiar and different at the same time. The sound is more raw and aggressive than a typical BMP. Please do not expect subtlety. This pedal does not “clean up well” with your volume knob. It doesn’t sound pretty. It’s probably not appropriate for waltzes or jazz standards. It’s not supposed to be. It smashes you in the face. Enjoy. Like all Mojo Hand FX products, this pedal is housed in a sturdy, die-cast aluminum enclosure with professional powder coating and printing. Features: -Tone Bypass Level (volume with tone circuit bypassed) -Level (volume with tone circuit engaged) -Tone -Gain -Left stomp switch bypasses/engages tone circuit -Right stomp switch bypasses/engages fuzz circuit -True bypass Power: -Standard center negative 9V DC supply (not included) -Current draw: ~8mA Dimensions: -4.7" L x 3.69" W x 1.37" H Related Products Rounder - A Nod to a Rare Fuzz Add to Cart Iron Bell - "Gilmour" Fuzz $169.00 Out of stock Verdigris Iron Bell - "Gilmour" Fuzz $169.00 Add to Cart Crosstown - Classic Germanium/Silicon Fuzz $179.00 Close × OK Footer Start Categories PEDALS Information Merchandise Retailers About Us INFO SUPPORT Sitemap Follow Us Mojo Hand FX 514 Lincoln Ave Holland, MI 49423 © 2026 Mojo Hand FX

About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Mojo Hand FX 1979 Back to results White Mojo Hand FX 1979 Fuzz Op-amp Big Muff from late-70s high-gain era—raw, aggressive fuzz that doesn't clean up with your volume knob. The 1979 resurrects the notoriously high-gain Big Muffs manufactured during the late 70s, when Electro-Harmonix switched from transistors to op-amps. This circuit change created something both familiar and different—more raw and aggressive than typical Big Muff variants. The pedal features a unique tone bypass circuit with dual switching: the left footswitch bypasses/engages the tone circuit entirely, while the right handles fuzz on/off. This gives you two distinct level controls—one for the tone circuit engaged, one for pure fuzz bypass. The manufacturer explicitly warns: "This pedal does not 'clean up well' with your volume knob. It doesn't sound pretty." Running on ~8mA from standard 9V center-negative power, the 1979 delivers uncompromising high-gain fuzz character. Die-cast aluminum enclosure with professional powder coating. Not for players seeking polite overdrive—this is aggressive, unruly fuzz.
